title: Sweet Chilli Ginger Sauce
preamble:
8 red chili peppers, finely chopped

120 ml rice vinegar

1 pinch(es) fresh ginger, minced

3 clove(s) garlic, minced

2 tbsp cilantro, chopped
method: Combine the chillies, sugar, water, rice vinegar, paprika, garlic and salt in a saucepan.
Bring to the boil and let simmer until the sugar dissolves and the mixture begins to thicken.
Add lime juice and simmer for another 1 minute.
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
